Author: Krishan Pahal

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:239080
Court No. - 72
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 13797 of 2023
Applicant :- Kishan And Another
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Ram Krishna Mishra

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.
2. Heard Sri Ram Krishna Mishra, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri R.P. Patel, learned A.G.A. for the State as well as perused the record.

3. The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicants in CNR No.-UPM001-009097-2023, S.C. No.1467 of 2023 (State vs. Vivek and Others) in Case Crime No.207 and 2023 registered under Sections 363, 342 and 120B I.P.C. at Police Station- Thakurdwara, District Moradabad with a prayer to enlarge them on anticipatory bail.
Kishan And Another vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180018785/
1 4.

entities.text: Kishan And Another vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants has stated that the applicants were granted anticipatory bail by this Court till the conclusion of trial in the instant case crime under Sections 498A, 323, 376, 506 I.P.C., Section 3/4 D.P. Act and Section 3/4 POCSO Act vide order dated 15.09.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No.9938 of 2023.

Subsequent to it,
final report (second charge-sheet) has been filed against the applicants and there are allegationsunder Sections 363, 342 and 120B I.P.C. only against the applicants, as such the applicants had to apply anticipatory bail in the said altered sections.
5. Learned counsel for the applicants has further stated that they have not misused the said opportunity granted earlier.
Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicants to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against them.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicants have also been touched upon at length.

Learned counsel for the applicants undertakes that they have co-operated in the investigation and are ready to do so in trial also failing which the State can move appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail.
6.
Per contra, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the anticipatory bail application but unable to dispute the submissions raised by the learned counsel for the applicants.

7. On due consideration to the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the applicants as well as learned A.G.A. and considering the nature of accusations and antecedents of the applicants, the applicants are liable to be enlarged on anticipatory bail in view of the judgment of Supreme Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1".

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The future contingencies regarding the anticipatory bail being granted to applicants shall also be taken care of as per the aforesaid judgment of the Apex Court.
8. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicants is allowed.

entities.text: Kishan And Another vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 9. It is made clear that observations made hereinabove are exclusively for deciding the instant anticipatory bail application and shall not affect the trial.

Order Date :- 18.12.2023 Ravi Kant (Krishan Pahal, J.)
